name: The One
source:
Thrust into the spotlight as the lead of a popular reality dating show, you face romance, intrigue, and the unveiling of deep, dark secrets. 

Will giving away pieces of your heart lead you to true love?

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/The_One]romance-club.fandom[/url]
translation:
作为一档热门恋爱真人秀的主角被推上聚光灯下后，你将面对浪漫恋情、明争暗斗，以及一个个浮出水面的黑暗秘密。

将真心一片片交付出去，最终能否引领你找到真爱？

[摘自[url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/The_One]romance-club.fandom[/url]]
